title: Nairobi health-worker work stoppage/strike reported 2 Nov
reason: The opened report primarily documents a labor strike and does not describe an independently dated, sized executed public gathering. “On the streets” is insufficient to code an assembly.

occurrence.summary: Work stoppage confirmed; separate assembly not described with particulars.

title: Mai Mahiu sand-harvester demonstration over Kedong Ranch fees
reason: CIVICUS reports a two-day demonstration and casualties beginning 10 Nov, but attributed grievance concerns fees charged by private Kedong Ranch, not a domestic state policy/target; participant threshold also absent. Not eligible on current evidence.

target.summary: Private ranch owners reportedly charged sand harvesting fees; no state-directed demand evidenced.
